Available Commands:

1. help - Display available commands and their descriptions.
2. dir - Display all of the files and folders in the current directory.
3. pop - Switch back to previous directory (e.g. go back).
4. login - Enter new login credentials to change the user & permissions.
5. cd <directory> - Change directory to navigate within the terminal system.
6. run <file_id> - Execute the exe file.
7. download <file_id> - Download content from target file.
8. scan <file_id> - Scan content from file.
9. read <file_id> - Reading content of file.
10. shutdown - Shutdown the terminal.

**Additional help**

> To find a file, try changing directories via cd <directory> and us the dir command to display all available files at the current level
> Some directories require special access. Use the login command to get Admin access. You may have to take a look at the users file to find the credentials.

# UICS TERMINAL SYSTEM – README

Welcome to the Unified Intercontinental Command Structure (UICS) Secure Terminal.

This terminal is part of the authorized network infrastructure under UICS Directive GridNet-4B. It is designed for use by certified personnel only. Access is monitored, logged, and subject to review by Central Systems Authority (CSA).

## SYSTEM FUNCTIONS

- **read** – Open and view a file's contents  
- **run** – Execute a script or terminal-compatible file  
- **scan** – Check a file for security classification or hidden data  
- **download** – Save a file from the terminal to your local device  

Need more info? Use the `help` command at any time for detailed usage.
## USER LEVELS

- Guest: View-only access to non-sensitive bulletins and maintenance schedules
- Admin: Full terminal control, including configuration management and override protocols

## CODE OF CONDUCT

- Always verify your clearance level before executing commands.
- Do not share access credentials under any circumstance.
- Report any system anomalies or suspicious activity using form 11-17A (System Irregularity Report).
- In case of compromised access, initiate Lockdown Sequence Alpha and disconnect from the local grid.

## SUPPORT CONTACT

For technical assistance, contact Central Systems Authority via secure channel [Node U-91].

## FINAL NOTICE

This terminal is property of the UICS. Unauthorized use is a breach of intercontinental security law and may result in disciplinary action, including confinement and clearance revocation.

UICS — Order. Stability. Control.

> END OF FILE

Document Title: "Factories – Site Overview"  
Date: 2024-11-28  
Classification: Confidential – Internal Distribution Only

Document successfully scanned and archived.  
Preview of Document Content:
-----------------------------------------------------
"FACILITY OVERVIEW – SITE BLOCK-7:  
The factory installation adjacent to the quarry remains fully operational and is responsible for high-volume processing of marble and composite concrete. The materials produced are used in structural reinforcement, subterranean encasement, and modular defensive installations.

Key operations include rotary crushing, thermal curing, and form compression. Automated batching units maintain a 24/7 output cycle. All export shipments are routed through controlled rail access under GridSec Protocol 6C.

Personnel clearance checks are enforced at two entry gates. Observation drones perform perimeter sweeps at 20-minute intervals. While the site is not classified as a high-risk zone, patrols have been increased following recent interference reports from nearby sectors.

Facility status: STABLE  
Output capacity: 91%  
Security recommendation: Maintain current protocols. Escalation unnecessary unless actionable intel is confirmed."

UICS strike elements are to initiate a rapid-entry operation targeting the bunker complex currently occupied by VLF-aligned forces. Primary objectives include clearing the command room and securing access to active data terminals. Secondary target is the adjacent cave structure—believed to serve as a fallback and storage zone for insurgent operatives.

Medical bay is to be isolated and swept for potential detainees or intel caches. Operation is time-sensitive. A brief communications blackout window has been scheduled to allow for silent breach and coordinated movement through critical access points..."

So I hear you’re one of the best to get shit done around here? If that’s true, got something that might interest you…

Know where the Edmonton Grain Factory is? It’s that grimey shithole not far from you.

After everyone fled and went running towards the cities for help, a group of degenerates took over and are hoarding all the supplies, attacking anyone that goes near the place.

I’ve heard it’s not only supplies they’re hoarding though; rumour has it government vehicles have been spotted going in and out of the place like clockwork… the same government that was supposed to have collapsed.

As far as I’m concerned, some shady shit is going on and if you’re up for the task, I’d like you to go there and search the place, see if you can find any files or evidence that explain what the fuck is going on.

I’ll make this worth your while.

Z
